Orange Pie Filling
By: Anonymous
Published: Wednesday, December 2, 2009 - 11:20pm

Ingredients




1 cup sugar
 cup flour
1/4 teaspoon salt
Grated rind of 1 orange
1 cup orange juice
2 tablespoons butter
Juice of ½ lemon
3 egg yolks

Preparation

1 Mix sugar, flour, salt and grated rind. Add fruit juice and cook in double boiler 10 minutes, stirring until thickened and afterward occasionally. Add butter and egg yolks beaten lightly. Cook 2 minutes and cool. Put in a crust that has been baked on outside of a tin pie plate. Cover with 8 minute meringue and bake.
